Strategy: Scale both the sweet-band reward and the mid penalty down to fifteen and gate the sweet band behind at least eight open bins, combining gentle steering with a strict gate. This keeps most Best Fit behavior intact, but the gate may rarely engage.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (15 if len(bins) >= 8 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
